manualAction.closeRule: Close a manual action only after its verification criteria are satisfied or an approved exception is documented.

productionActivationChecklist: Create and validate two Emergency Access accounts and phishing-resistant authentication.
Close all Critical/High Manual Actions or document an approved exception.
Add test users/devices to DER Pilot groups.
Review compliance, Defender, ASR, Network Protection and Controlled Folder Access results.
Review Conditional Access Report-only impact and geo/travel exceptions.
Only after validation, transition Security Defaults/Conditional Access as appropriate.

engineerHandoff.closeRule: Do not call the tenant finished until failed validations are resolved or approved as exceptions, Critical/High manual actions are closed, configuration drift is reviewed, and production promotion has been explicitly approved.
